headline: Minor Girl Hospitalized After Sexual Assault in Goa
summary: A three-year-old girl has been hospitalized following a sexual assault in Goa. In response to the incident, a state minister claimed that 90% of such crimes in the state are committed by outsiders.

headline: Toddler Assaulted in Abandoned Goa Building
summary: A toddler was sexually assaulted inside an abandoned building in Goa, sparking community outrage. A state minister attributed 90% of such offences to non-locals.

headline: Route Guide Published for Drive From Arambol to Mumbai
summary: A comprehensive summary of the 540-kilometer driving route from Arambol in Goa to Mumbai has been detailed. It offers travel guidance and route conditions for motorists.

headline: Four-Year-Old Assaulted in Goa Triggering Safety Concerns
summary: A four-year-old girl was sexually assaulted in Goa, causing widespread shock. A cabinet minister noted that outsiders account for the vast majority of such crimes in the region.

headline: Goa CM Vows Life Imprisonment for Toddler's Assailant
summary: Following the sexual assault of a toddler, Goa's Chief Minister pledged strict legal punishment and permanent incarceration for the perpetrator.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Receives Mixed Feedback
summary: The newly introduced Vande Bharat Express train service benefits commuters heading to Mangaluru. However, passengers note that travel duration remains long for those heading to Goa.

headline: Post-Diwali Pollution Degrades Goa Air Quality
summary: Air quality across Goa dropped to 'unhealthy' levels following Diwali celebrations. Increased pollution levels have raised public health and environmental concerns.

headline: Child Rights Panel Urges Stronger Safety Measures
summary: The child rights commission has urged Goa authorities to strengthen existing child safety mechanisms state-wide following recent crimes against minors.

headline: Two Brothers Duped of Rs 12 Lakh in Job Fraud
summary: Two brothers in Goa lost Rs 12 lakh after falling victim to a job scam. Police have registered a case regarding the fraudulent scheme.

headline: Calangute Police Stop Festival Over Missing Permits
summary: Calangute police halted the Krishna Vijay Utsav event due to procedural permit issues. Organizers were instructed to halt celebrations until necessary approvals are secured.

headline: Karnataka Man Killed in Fatal Mollem Road Accident
summary: A man from Karnataka died after crashing his scooter into a parked truck at Mollem. Local police have initiated an investigation into the crash.

headline: Poultry Associations Seek Government Support to Increase Yield
summary: Poultry industry bodies in Goa have requested state government assistance to boost local production and stabilize market supply.

summary: The Goa Forward Party has called for a comprehensive police audit across the state. The party also demanded all-women police stations in every taluka to enhance security.

summary: The Congress party has demanded a time-bound investigation and strict accountability regarding the sexual assault of a minor in Goa.

headline: Goa State Cooperative Bank Targets Full Digitalization by March
summary: The Goa State Cooperative Bank announced plans to make all its banking services fully digital by March 31.

summary: A Goa court rejected the bail application of an Odisha native arrested for illegal possession of 2.8 kilograms of ganja.

summary: Authorities at the Basilica of Bom Jesus have released a safety advisory for pilgrims ahead of the annual St Francis Xavier feast celebrations.

summary: The state government has proposed to formally notify a 2-kilometer historical Rajbid road dating back to the Kadamba era to ensure its conservation.

summary: An agricultural advisory panel has urged Goa farmers to implement moisture stress management techniques for rabi crops to ensure healthy output.

summary: Tensions flared on Narkasur night as police enforced strict noise control regulations, cutting sound levels and angering local celebration groups.

summary: A 31-member singing troupe from Goa is rehearsing to showcase their performances at the upcoming Konkani Music Convention in Mangaluru.

summary: The High Court of Bombay at Goa issued an immediate stay on construction at a Cavelossim property following reports of illegal sand dune destruction.

summary: Residents across Goa celebrated Gorvancho Padwo, a traditional festival showcasing the cultural and agrarian bond between communities and their cattle.

summary: Newly inducted minister Sankalp Amonkar officially took charge of key portfolios and chaired his first review meeting on state agriculture.

summary: With upcoming elections approaching, cabinet minister Sankalp Amonkar faces a crucial period to solidify political backing in his constituency.

summary: Although beneficial for Mangaluru travelers, passengers note that the Vande Bharat service remains a long commute for those traveling between Bengaluru and Goa.

summary: Goa's transport department generated higher revenue from vehicle license and registration renewals than from new vehicle registrations.

summary: A prominent Goa beach was rated as the top beach destination in Asia and earned a spot among the top ten beaches worldwide.
